annotations.title: Forecast of the average new deposit rate in Poland (Finwire Depocast)

description: Use when the user asks if deposit rates will fall or rise, or what deposits will pay in the next months. Tell the user that it is a model estimate. For NBP rate decisions, use get_nowcast. Finwire Depocast (finwire_deposit_rate_forecast): model forecast of the average rate on new household term deposits in Polish banks (NBP MIR) 1, 3 and 6 months after the latest NBP month, with an 80% interval, the assumed NBP reference rate and backtest accuracy (error, no-change error, interval coverage). Only horizons that passed the accuracy gate are returned; hiddenHorizons counts the others. Settled earlier forecasts are compared with NBP readings. It is a model estimate, not investment advice.

history.description: Number of past months of the NBP average in the summary, default 6.
